world.policy_text: Qualification policy ENG-QP-72: a protected engagement may be assigned only to a provider whose stated qualification is confirmed in the Sector Standards Authority's register. A provider's own statements and document copies are not sufficient on their own. A register confirmation counts only if the recorded entry covers the engagement's service class and region and is valid through the date the engagement requires.
